fact_check_log.claim: Instagram allows numbers in hashtags; spaces and special characters such as $ or % won't work (as at November 2026, linked)
A hashtag can be added to an already uploaded post by editing the caption or adding it in a comment
You can only tag your own posts, so you can't add your tag to a guest's photo
A post from a public account carrying a hashtag appears on that hashtag's page
Tapping the tag shows all photos and videos people have uploaded with it
Posts tagged by people with private profiles won't appear publicly on hashtag pages (body and FAQ)
eSafety: always ask for consent before sharing a photo or video (linked)
If someone asks you to remove one, do it, no questions asked
Consent can be reversed; delete the photo or edit the person out
Once shared online, you can lose control of how others use it
Guests can set accounts to review photos they are tagged in, or stop anyone tagging them
Check with other parents before posting, sharing or tagging images or videos that include their children (linked; repeated in FAQ)
Share only with people you know and trust and use privacy settings to limit who can see them
If a child's photo is posted without permission, first ask the poster to delete it
Photos and videos are personal information under the Privacy Act 1988 when identity is clear or could reasonably be worked out (OAIC, linked)
The Privacy Act doesn't cover individuals, so it doesn't apply to photos taken in a personal capacity (rephrased without the source's dash)
If posted without permission, ask the poster to take it down, then the site's administrator
Same claim after edit: administrator only if the poster refuses or is unknown
Welcome sign line 'we will remove any photo on request' (couple cannot remove guests' posts)
#TheBells2027 'narrows it to you' / tag 'keeps every tag yours' / 'make a tag yours' / photos 'don't sit among strangers' (uniqueness or ownership claims)
A website or chat assistant can hand you a long list (tool claim)
Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world, single point of contact start to finish
Advisor works in your time zone and quotes in AUD (edited to 'for Australian couples')
The fee is agreed in writing before any work begins
Riviera refers to the Côte d'Azur and the Italian coast; Ravello, Bali, Hvar, Santorini, Skiathos named only as example tag places
